parameters.query: INSERT INTO radar_hub.opportunities (category, title, description, original_price, opportunity_price, net_profit_estimate, source_name, source_url, evaluation_score, priority) VALUES ($1::radar_hub.opportunity_type, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10::radar_hub.priority_level) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id;
